records.source_Japanese:
まるで燃える炎のような色をしている
不思議な宝石らしい
records.source_meaning: Apparently a mysterious jewel whose color resembles burning flames.
records.context: The native informant tells the player that the Ancient Map may lead to legendary treasure, then describes the rumored artifact. The same artifact index selects the inscription in the map document. This is a spoken account with its own hearsay, doubts and reactions.
records.speaker: Guildmaster
records.current_English: They say it's a strange jewel the color of a blazing fire.
records.english: They say it's a strange jewel the color of a blazing fire.
records.localization_note: The flame comparison stays vivid and the Guildmaster marks the jewel as hearsay.
previous_lines: They say it's a strange jewel the
color of a blazing fire.
visible_lines: They say it's a strange jewel the
color of a blazing fire.

records.source_Japanese:
相当古い時代の短剣だという
何やら文字が刻まれているそうだが
今となっては読める者もいないだろう
records.source_meaning: Said to be a very ancient dagger with an inscription. The speaker doubts that anyone can read it in the present day; this is uncertainty rather than a proven unreadable language.
records.context: The native informant tells the player that the Ancient Map may lead to legendary treasure, then describes the rumored artifact. The same artifact index selects the inscription in the map document. This is a spoken account with its own hearsay, doubts and reactions.
records.speaker: Guildmaster
records.current_English: They say it's an ancient dagger with writing on it. I doubt anyone can still read it.
records.english: They say it's an ancient dagger with writing on it. I doubt anyone can still read it.
records.localization_note: The ancient blade and engraving lead naturally to the speaker’s doubts about reading it.
previous_lines: They say it's an ancient dagger
with writing on it. I doubt anyone
can still read it.
visible_lines: They say it's an ancient dagger
with writing on it. I doubt anyone
can still read it.

records.source_Japanese:
大昔の神官が使った石の面で
不気味な蛇の模様を彫りこんで
あるって話だ
records.source_meaning: Reportedly a stone mask used by ancient priests and engraved with an unsettling serpent design.
records.context: The native informant tells the player that the Ancient Map may lead to legendary treasure, then describes the rumored artifact. The same artifact index selects the inscription in the map document. This is a spoken account with its own hearsay, doubts and reactions.
records.speaker: Guildmaster
records.current_English: I hear priests used this stone mask long ago. It's carved with an eerie serpent pattern.
records.english: I hear priests used this stone mask long ago. It's carved with an eerie serpent pattern.
records.localization_note: The former priests and unsettling serpent carving are clearly conveyed. The carving phrase remains together.
previous_lines: I hear priests used this stone mask
long ago. It's carved with an eerie
serpent pattern.
visible_lines: I hear priests used this stone mask
long ago. It's carved with an eerie
serpent pattern.

records.source_Japanese:
紅色の水晶なんだが、透かすと中に
星形の模様が浮かんで見えるって話だ
records.source_meaning: A crimson crystal in which a star-shaped design reportedly appears when viewed through the crystal.
records.context: The native informant tells the player that the Ancient Map may lead to legendary treasure, then describes the rumored artifact. The same artifact index selects the inscription in the map document. This is a spoken account with its own hearsay, doubts and reactions.
records.speaker: Guildmaster
records.current_English: It's a crimson crystal. Hold it to the light and, they say, a star-shaped pattern appears inside.
records.english: It's a crimson crystal. Hold it up to the light. The story goes you'll see a star pattern inside.
records.localization_note: Keep the color, action and reported effect. The star pattern becomes a complete closing phrase.
previous_lines: It's a crimson crystal. Hold it to
the light and, they say, a
star-shaped pattern appears inside.
visible_lines: It's a crimson crystal. Hold it up
to the light. The story goes you'll
see a star pattern inside.

records.source_Japanese:
中に金剛石が入っている不思議な
水晶だって言われている
宝石を食う宝石だって、な
records.source_meaning: Reportedly a mysterious crystal containing a diamond, nicknamed a jewel that consumes jewels.
records.context: The native informant tells the player that the Ancient Map may lead to legendary treasure, then describes the rumored artifact. The same artifact index selects the inscription in the map document. This is a spoken account with its own hearsay, doubts and reactions.
records.speaker: Guildmaster
records.current_English: They say there's a diamond inside this strange crystal. They call it a jewel that eats jewels.
records.english: They say there's a diamond inside this strange crystal. They call it a jewel that eats jewels.
records.localization_note: The reported diamond comes before the playful jewel-eating nickname, with the entire nickname on its line.
previous_lines: They say there's a diamond inside
this strange crystal. They call it
a jewel that eats jewels.
visible_lines: They say there's a diamond inside
this strange crystal. They call it
a jewel that eats jewels.

records.source_Japanese:
大した切れ味の刀らしい
嘘か本当か、触れずにものを
切り落とすというからな
records.source_meaning: Apparently a very sharp sword; whether true or false, it is said to sever things without contact. Preserve the speaker's doubt.
records.context: The native informant tells the player that the Ancient Map may lead to legendary treasure, then describes the rumored artifact. The same artifact index selects the inscription in the map document. This is a spoken account with its own hearsay, doubts and reactions.
records.speaker: Guildmaster
records.current_English: They say that sword is sharp enough to cut without touching a thing. Who knows if it's true?
records.english: They say that sword is sharp enough to cut without touching a thing. Who knows if it's true?
records.localization_note: The extravagant claim about cutting without contact and the Guildmaster’s doubt remain distinct.
previous_lines: They say that sword is sharp enough
to cut without touching a thing.
Who knows if it's true?
visible_lines: They say that sword is sharp enough
to cut without touching a thing.
Who knows if it's true?

records.source_Japanese:
セイレーンの姿の像らしい
船首像に使っていたとか聞いたが
船を遭難させる魔女の像を使うだなんて
信じられんよ
records.source_meaning: Reportedly a siren statue used as a ship's figurehead. The speaker is incredulous at using an image of a witch that causes maritime disasters.
records.context: The native informant tells the player that the Ancient Map may lead to legendary treasure, then describes the rumored artifact. The same artifact index selects the inscription in the map document. This is a spoken account with its own hearsay, doubts and reactions.
records.speaker: Guildmaster
records.current_English: I hear it's a statue of a Siren, once used as a figurehead. A witch that wrecks ships, right on the bow? Hard to believe.
records.english: It's a statue of a Siren, I hear. They say it served as a figurehead. A shipwrecking witch on the bow? Hard to believe.
records.localization_note: The Guildmaster reports the former use and then expresses disbelief. Keep the startling image of a witch on the bow together.
previous_lines: I hear it's a statue of a Siren,
once used as a figurehead. A witch
that wrecks ships, right on the
bow? Hard to believe.
visible_lines: It's a statue of a Siren, I hear.
They say it served as a figurehead.
A shipwrecking witch on the bow?
Hard to believe.

records.source_Japanese:
ねじまがったツノなんだそうだ
竜のツノだって言うやつもいる
どんな病にも効く薬になるって
噂もある
records.source_meaning: Reportedly a twisted horn, with some saying it belongs to a dragon and rumors claiming it can be made into medicine effective against every illness.
records.context: The native informant tells the player that the Ancient Map may lead to legendary treasure, then describes the rumored artifact. The same artifact index selects the inscription in the map document. This is a spoken account with its own hearsay, doubts and reactions.
records.speaker: Guildmaster
records.current_English: It's supposed to be a twisted horn. Some say it came from a dragon. Word is, you can turn it into medicine that cures any illness.
records.english: It's supposed to be a twisted horn. Some say it came from a dragon. Word is, you can turn it into medicine that cures any illness.
records.localization_note: The registered Lisbon revision keeps the three reported claims separate and the remedy on one line.
previous_lines: It's supposed to be a twisted horn.
Some say it came from a dragon.
Word is, you can turn it into
medicine that cures any illness.
visible_lines: It's supposed to be a twisted horn.
Some say it came from a dragon.
Word is, you can turn it into
medicine that cures any illness.

records.source_Japanese:
偉大な王様が持っていた盾らしい
女神の姿が描かれているって話だ
船乗りにとって最高のお守りだとも
言われている
records.source_meaning: Apparently the shield of a great king, reportedly bearing a goddess's image and said to be the best protective charm for sailors.
records.context: The native informant tells the player that the Ancient Map may lead to legendary treasure, then describes the rumored artifact. The same artifact index selects the inscription in the map document. This is a spoken account with its own hearsay, doubts and reactions.
records.speaker: Guildmaster
records.current_English: They say this shield belonged to a great king and bears a goddess's image. Sailors call it their best charm.
records.english: They say it's a great king's shield with a goddess pictured on it. Sailors say there's no finer charm.
records.localization_note: Retain the reported ownership, image and the sailors’ praise. Keep the charm claim in one phrase.
previous_lines: They say this shield belonged to a
great king and bears a goddess's
image. Sailors call it their best
charm.
visible_lines: They say it's a great king's shield
with a goddess pictured on it.
Sailors say there's no finer charm.

records.source_Japanese:
とんでもなく大きな槍らしい
邪悪なものを退ける力があるって話だ

records.context: The native informant tells the player that the Ancient Map may lead to legendary treasure, then describes the rumored artifact. The same artifact index selects the inscription in the map document. This is a spoken account with its own hearsay, doubts and reactions.
records.speaker: Guildmaster
records.current_English: I hear it's an enormous spear capable of driving evil away.
records.english: I hear it's an enormous spear capable of driving evil away.
records.localization_note: The spear’s extraordinary size and rumored power to drive away evil are complete and readable.

capable of driving evil away.
